description: size getter: dedup guard inverted so only keys present in BOTH caches are counted toward oldCacheSize, instead of keys present only in #oldCache. Gap: in makeCache() setup (#size=1, #oldCache={a,b}, #cache={a}, maxSize=2), inverted guard counts 'a' (overlap) → oldCacheSize=1 → min(1+1,2)=2 which equals the correct answer; similarly in the maxSize:3 partial-oldCache scenario (#oldCache={a,c}, #cache={a}) → counts 'a' → oldCacheSize=1 → min(1+1,3)=2; both fp-10 size assertions still pass.
productionImpact: The size getter counts only keys shared between both caches and ignores keys exclusive to #oldCache. Any application branching on cache size — eviction thresholds, capacity monitors, or resize logic — sees a count that omits #oldCache-only entries, causing under-eviction and silent cache overflow beyond the declared maxSize.
